description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesList' that displays a list of notes with search, pagination, and delete functionalities. It interacts with external API services to fetch and delete notes, manages local state for UI interactions, and renders the notes or loading skeletons accordingly.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on current page, page size, and search parameters.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note after user confirmation and refreshes the notes list.
